51594262.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant His-tagged human TIM-3 expressed in HEK293 assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) experiments were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (Cytiva) at 25 °C. Recombinant His-tagged human TIM-3 (Sino Biological, Cat. #10002-H08H) was immobilized on a CM5 sensor chip (Cytiva) via amine coupling. The immobilization level was approximately 1000 response units (RU). The running buffer was HBS-EP+ (10 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20, pH 7.4). Peptides were diluted in the running buffer and injected at concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 1000 nM at a flow rate of 30 μL/min. Association was allowed for 120 s, followed by a 120 s dissociation phase. Regeneration was performed with 10 mM glycine-HCl (pH 2.0) for 30 s. Data were analyzed using Biacore T200 Evaluation Software v3.0. The dissociation constant (K_D) was determined by fitting the sensorgrams to a 1:1 Langmuir binding model.
